items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Mo Gale was the owner of the ballroom and the manager of Chick Webb

ctx.x: That's Charlie Buchanan. He was (inaudible), and Mo Gale was the owner of the ballroom and the manager of Chick Webb, and they (inaudible). Oh, you're trying to create a revolution here. You're Latino. You're Franco. You're dictators. I say, no, I'm not a dictator. I think we deserve money. You get money for the band. How you know? I say, well, listen. I thought a deal was going on, you know.

So the guy's so bad, went to the Paramount Theater, I said this is it. So Chick called me, said, Mario, I've got to give you your notice. I said, all right. Well, gave my two week notice. So the day I'm supposed to leave he come into the dressing room. He start crying, don't want me to leave.
